content.title: Richmond - Dentistry - Virginia Commonwealth University
content.text: Virginia Commonwealth University Give VCU’s home in Richmond Located in Richmond, Virginia, the Virginia Commonwealth University School of Dentistry resides at a bustling intersection of medicine, business, politics and culture. Combining the amenities of a major metropolitan area with the charm and convenience of a moderately sized city, Richmond, the state capital, offers a unique urban backdrop for study, work and play. At the heart of VCU Medical Center, the School of Dentistry is just blocks away from downtown Richmond’s financial and government center and a short drive from several popular retail districts. Many of our students and faculty reside in nearby historical neighborhoods like Church Hill and the Fan, taking advantage of the James River, a thriving arts scene and plentiful dining options — just a few reasons the city consistently ranks among the best places to live and work in America in several national publications.
